public_rationale: The claim, from a post published 2024-09-16, is that generative AI, including GPT and ChatGPT, does not solve the complex problems that would justify its massive costs. Whether benefits justify costs is a value judgment. The post does not say which problems count as complex, which benefits count, or which costs (training, inference, capital) are included. Any test would need the evaluator to supply those standards, and no plain reading settles them. The evidence packet has no evidence items, and the one source it considered was not used. This claim is therefore not scored.
limitations: Not scoring this claim says nothing about whether the view is right or wrong.
The packet has no evidence on what problems generative AI solves or what it costs, so no factual finding on either is made here.
Financial results alone, such as company losses, would not settle whether benefits justify costs.
